about: The communio of the formulary “16th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, I will be mindful of Your justice alone; O God, You have taught me from my youth; and even into old age and decline, O God, do not forsake me.

ex.w004: Tuæ solíus means that the justice belongs to God alone. Solíus refers to God, not to the noun iustítiæ.
